target.statement: Spearman rank correlation between GLYCEMIC CONTROL and COG-FUNC in the Ohio Longitudinal Cognitive Dataset: rho_s = 0.208, p = 5.29e-5 (n=373), surviving Holm correction

compute.basis: A single Spearman correlation on a 373-row public table is trivial compute; the cost is downloading OASIS, guessing the paper's 'GLYCEMIC CONTROL'/'COG-FUNC' composite definitions, and re-deriving them since no code is released.

blockers: No code or notebook released despite 'full reproducibility' claim
Composite variables GLYCEMIC CONTROL and COG-FUNC are not defined operationally, so exact rho=0.208 is unlikely to be reproduced
OASIS longitudinal data requires free registration/DUA acceptance
title: A Unified Three-Stage Machine Learning Framework for Diabetes Detection, Subtype Discrimination, and Cognitive-Metabolic Hypothesis Testing
